question.text: The abbreviated bid-offer price for USD/INR is quoted as 82.0525/75. What is the full offer price?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 22, for four-decimal currency pairs the offer is quoted in terms of the last two decimal places. USDINR 82.0525/82.0575 is therefore abbreviated as 82.0525/75, so '75' represents the last two decimals and the full offer is 82.0575. The Trap: 82.7500 incorrectly treats '75' as replacing the first two decimals after the point rather than the last two. Note: Page 23 confirms that USDJPY follows a two-decimal convention, while four-decimal pairs like USDINR abbreviate only the last two digits of the offer.
